episode_title: Empowering Inheritors to Realize the Purpose of their Family Capital With Andrew Wolk

real_qa.q: What outcomes movement does Finding Common Purpose promote for working Americans?
real_qa.r: Finding Common Purpose advocates for an outcomes movement that judges whether working Americans are thriving based on housing, mental health, savings, wages, healthcare, and community indicators. The foundation grants into communities to help them focus on measurable outcomes like housing and childcare and wages, setting baselines to allow people to debate policy solutions that can move these metrics.

real_qa.q: Why did only 4% of kids in Detroit read at grade level according to Andrew Wolk's research?
real_qa.r: Andrew Wolk discovered that 4% of kids in Detroit were reading at grade level, and this outcome had remained static for 10 years. This finding led him to question why the philanthropy and nonprofit sectors were not focusing on outcomes and measurable results, becoming a pivotal moment in understanding the outcomes movement.

real_qa.q: What percentage of Steamboat Springs residents spend on housing versus the federal standard?
real_qa.r: In Steamboat Springs, Colorado, where Finding Common Purpose operates, 50% of residents spend more than 50% of their income on housing, compared to the federal government standard of no more than 30%. In childcare, families in Steamboat Springs spend 24% while the recommended threshold is 10%.

real_qa.q: What three pivotal moments shaped Andrew Wolk's career as a social entrepreneur and philanthropist?
real_qa.r: Wolk's first pivotal moment came when he left Wall Street to start a restaurant delivery service and discovered greater satisfaction in helping struggling employees build skills. His second pivotal moment occurred 10 years into his career when research revealed only 4% of kids in Detroit read at grade level, sparking his focus on outcomes. The third pivotal moment came when he became a philanthropist and converted Finding Common Purpose into a grant-making foundation to fund communities focused on measurable outcomes.
